function.arguments: {"index": 1, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "The finding concerns confounding between species and island, which would matter if we were comparing groups (e.g., mean flipper length by species). However, the current estimand is the Pearson correlation between two continuous variables (flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g) computed over all penguins. Correlation is a global measure of linear association and is not confounded by an imbalance in species or island distribution. Therefore, the association between species and island does not bias the Pearson correlation coefficient. The finding is dismissed."}
function.name: resolve_finding
